toolCalls.args: {"command":"Get-Content .\\input\\session.jsonl | Select-Object -Skip 4 -First 40 | ForEach-Object { $j = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $j.payload; $t = $p.type; if ($t -eq 'event_msg') { \"[$($j.ordinal)] event_msg type=$($p.type)\"; if ($p.payload) { $p.payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 -Compress } } elseif ($t -eq 'response_item') { $role = $p.role; $txt = ($p.content | ForEach-Object { if ($_.type -eq 'input_text') { $_.text } elseif ($_.type -eq 'output_text') { $_.text } }) -join ' '; $len = $txt.Length; \"[$($j.ordinal)] resp role=$role len=$len\"; if ($len -gt 0 -and $len -le 1200) { $txt.Substring(0,[Math]::Min($len,1200)) } } else { \"[$($j.ordinal)] other type=$t\" } }"}

{"command":"$lines = Get-Content .\\input\\session.jsonl -Encoding UTF8; $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; foreach ($line in $lines) { try { $j = $line | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $out.Add(\"PARSE-FAIL\"); continue }; if ($j.type -eq 'response_item') { $p = $j.payload; if ($p.type -eq 'message') { $txt = ($p.content | ForEach-Object { if ($_.type -eq 'input_text' -or $_.type -eq 'output_text') { $_.text } }) -join \"`n\"; if ($txt) { $short = if ($txt.Length -gt 900) { $txt.Substring(0,900) + ' ...[truncated]' } else { $txt }; $out.Add(\"[ord $($j.ordinal)] ROLE=$($p.role)`n$short\") } } } }; $out | ForEach-Object { $_; \"----\" }"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $lines = Get-Content .\\input\\session.jsonl -Encoding UTF8; $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; foreach ($line in $lines) { try { $j = $line | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $out.Add(\"PARSE-FAIL at line for ordinal\"); continue }; if ($j.type -eq 'response_item') { $p = $j.payload; if ($p.type -eq 'message') { $txt = ($p.content | ForEach-Object { if ($_.type -eq 'input_text' -or $_.type -eq 'output_text') { $_.text } }) -join \"`n\"; if ($txt) { $short = if ($txt.Length -gt 4000) { $txt.Substring(0,4000) + ' ...[truncated]' } else { $txt }; $out.Add(\"[ord $($j.ordinal)] ROLE=$($p.role)`n$short\") } } } }; $out | ForEach-Object { $_; \"----\" }"}

{"command":"$lines = Get-Content .\\input\\session.jsonl -Encoding UTF8; foreach ($line in $lines) { try { $j = $line | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }; if ($j.type -eq 'response_item') { $p = $j.payload; $extra = ''; if ($p.type -eq 'message') { $extra = 'role=' + $p.role } elseif ($p.type -eq 'reasoning') { $extra = 'summary=' + [string]($p.summary) } elseif ($p.type -eq 'custom_tool_call') { $extra = 'name=' + $p.name; if ($p.arguments) { $a = $p.arguments | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 4; $extra += ' args=' + $a.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(220,$a.Length)) } } elseif ($p.type -eq 'custom_tool_call_output') { $o = $p.output; $extra = 'outputlen=' + ([string]$o).Length } ; \"ord=$($j.ordinal) itemtype=$($p.type) $extra\" } elseif ($j.type -eq 'event_msg') { $p = $j.payload; $extra = ''; if ($p.type -eq 'item_completed') { $it = $p.item; if ($it) { $extra = \"itemtype=$($it.type) status=$($it.status)\" } } elseif ($p.type -eq 'task_started') { $extra = \"task_started\" }; \"ord=$($j.ordinal) event=$($p.type) $extra\" } elseif ($j.type -in @('world_state','turn_context','token_usage_record','session_meta')) { \"ord=$($j.ordinal) type=$($j.type)\" } }"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $lines = Get-Content .\\input\\session.jsonl -Encoding UTF8; $line = $lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\"ordinal\":81' }; $j = $line | ConvertFrom-Json; $txt = ($j.payload.content | ForEach-Object { if ($_.type -eq 'output_text') { $_.text } }) -join \"`n\"; $txt.Substring([Math]::Min(3800,$txt.Length))"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $lines = Get-Content .\\input\\session.jsonl -Encoding UTF8; foreach ($ord in @(14,21,28,35,44,51,64,71)) { $line = $lines | Where-Object { $_ -match ('\"ordinal\":' + $ord + ',') } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $line) { continue }; try { $j = $line | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }; $p = $j.payload; $cmd = ''; if ($p.type -eq 'custom_tool_call') { $a = $p.arguments; $cmd = $a.command }; if ($cmd) { $c = if ($cmd.Length -gt 900) { $cmd.Substring(0,900) + ' …' } else { $cmd }; \"=== ord $ord $($p.name) ===`n$c\" } }"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $lines = Get-Content .\\input\\session.jsonl -Encoding UTF8; foreach ($ord in @(14,21,28,35,44,51,64,71)) { $line = $lines | Where-Object { $_ -match ('\"ordinal\":' + $ord + ',') } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $line) { \"no line for $ord\"; continue }; try { $j = $line | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { \"parse fail ord $ord\"; continue }; $p = $j.payload; if ($p.type -eq 'custom_tool_call') { $argJson = $p.arguments | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress; $txt = ($p.input | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress); \"=== ord $ord name=$($p.name) ===\"; $argJson.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(1400,$argJson.Length)) } }"}
